p01.location_text: บ้านเลขที่ 45 หมู่ 7 ต.เวียงพางคำ
p01.summary: Bedridden elder and two children trapped on a roof as water reaches the second floor in Wiang Phang Kham, Mae Sai; boat needed.

p02.location_text: บ้านเลขที่ 45 หมู่ 7 ต.เวียงพางคำ
p02.summary: Repost: bedridden elder and two children trapped on a roof in Wiang Phang Kham, Mae Sai; boat needed.

p03.location_text: บ้านเลขที่ 45 ม.7 เวียงพางคำ
p03.summary: Same rescue request: elder and children on a roof at house 45, Moo 7, Wiang Phang Kham, Mae Sai.

p04.location_text: ถนนพหลโยธิน หน้าตลาดสายลมจอย
p04.summary: Phahonyothin Rd at Sailomjoy market, Mae Sai, under ~1.5 m of fast water; impassable for cars.

p05.location_text: โรงเรียนอนุบาลแม่สาย
p05.summary: Mae Sai kindergarten shelter holds ~300 evacuees and lacks drinking water, blankets and infant formula.

p06.location_text: แม่น้ำกก สถานีเชียงราย
p06.summary: Kok River at Chiang Rai gauge 5.2 m, 0.4 m above bank; riverside city areas expected to flood tonight.

p07.location_text: ชุมชนเกาะลอย
p07.summary: Water entering Ko Loi community, Mueang Chiang Rai; about 50 households affected and moving belongings up.

p08.location_text: หมู่บ้านป่าแดด
p08.summary: Diabetic patient cut off by water for two days in Pa Daet village, Mueang Chiang Mai, urgently needs insulin.

p09.location_text: สะพานนวรัฐ ถนนเจริญประเทศ ถนนช้างคลาน ไนท์บาซาร์
p09.summary: Ping River over its banks at Nawarat Bridge; Charoen Prathet and Chang Klan roads under 50 cm, night bazaar shops damaged.

p10.summary: Night bazaar area flooded ~50 cm on Chang Klan Rd; guesthouses moving guests upstairs.

p11.location_text: อ.ฝาง และ อ.แม่อาย
p11.summary: Rescue foundation volunteers with 5 boats operating in Fang and Mae Ai districts.

p12.location_text: ตลาดเทศบาลเมืองสุโขทัย
p12.summary: Yom River flooding Sukhothai municipal market; over 100 shops damaged and water still rising.

p13.summary: About 2,000 rai of rice fields submerged in Si Samrong district.

p14.location_text: ต.บ้านกร่าง
p14.summary: Family of six trapped with water near the second floor and no food since yesterday in Ban Krang, Mueang Phitsanulok.

p15.location_text: ภาคเหนือตอนล่าง น่าน แพร่ อุตรดิตถ์
p15.summary: TMD warns of very heavy rain over Nan, Phrae and Uttaradit; flash floods and landslides possible in the next 24–48 h.

p16.summary: Flash flood hit homes in Tha Wang Pha; one bridge washed out and a village cut off.

p17.location_text: ถนนสาย 101 อ.เมืองแพร่ - อ.ร้องกวาง
p17.summary: Route 101 between Mueang Phrae and Rong Kwang blocked by a landslide; use Highway 11.

p18.location_text: ริมแม่น้ำเจ้าพระยา อ.บางบาล
p18.summary: Chao Phraya Dam release raised to 2,400 m³/s; Ayutthaya and Bang Ban riverside residents told to move belongings up.

p19.location_text: บ้านริมน้ำเจ้าพระยา อ.บางบาล
p19.summary: About 80 riverside households flooded in Bang Ban; sandbags and rowing boats needed.

p20.location_text: วัดไชยวัฒนาราม
p20.summary: Relief bags distributed at Wat Chaiwatthanaram tomorrow 9:00 for flood victims.

p21.summary: Chao Phraya at Pak Nam Pho 24.8 m MSL and slowly rising; riverside communities on watch.

p22.location_text: ถนนเพชรเกษม
p22.summary: Heavy overnight rain in Hat Yai; Phetkasem Rd under 70 cm and water entering homes in many municipal sois.

p23.location_text: ซ.ราษฎร์อุทิศ 2
p23.summary: Pregnant woman near labour trapped in waist-deep water at Soi Rat Uthit 2, Hat Yai; needs transport to hospital.

p24.summary: Ranot district flooded for 5 days; over 1,200 people short of clean water and food.

p25.summary: Three bedridden patients need evacuation in Cha-uat; rescue teams cannot reach yet.

p26.location_text: ถนนสาย 41 ช่วง อ.ทุ่งสง
p26.summary: Route 41 near Thung Song flooded; small vehicles barred.

p27.location_text: หอประชุมอำเภอสุไหงโก-ลก
p27.summary: Kolok River rising in Su-ngai Kolok; evacuation centre opened at the district hall.

p28.summary: Volunteer kitchen in Hat Yai can cook 500 meals/day and asks for rice, eggs and water donations.

p30.summary: Retrospective about the 2011 floods, not a current event.
